concept: X-Ray: distributed tracing to find latency in microservices
tests: Which service provides end-to-end request tracing across microservices.
expected: AWS X-Ray traces requests across distributed services, with a service map and latency analysis. Triggers: "trace requests across microservices", "find bottlenecks", "end-to-end tracing".
why_not: CloudWatch Logs stores logs; CloudTrail is API calls; Config is configuration; none provide request traces.
